abilities.critical_failure: The creature is frightened 2 and fleeing for as long as it remains frightened.
abilities.effect: The stone statue lurches to life, its branches whipping through the air as a horrifying roar rips through the monastery—a roar that seems to come from underground. All intruders within the monastery must attempt a DC 21 Will save. The haunt then rolls initiative.
abilities.name: Pulse of Fear

traits.name: Emotion
traits.text: This effect alters a creature’s emotions. Effects with this trait always have the mental trait as well. Creatures with special training or that have mechanical or artificial intelligence are immune to emotion effects.

traits.name: Enchantment
traits.text: Effects and magic items with this trait are associated with the enchantment school of magic, typically involving mind control, emotion alteration, and other mental effects.

traits.name: Fear
traits.text: Fear effects evoke the emotion of fear. Effects with this trait always have the mental and emotion traits as well.

traits.name: Mental
traits.text: A mental effect can alter the target’s mind. It has no effect on an object or a mindless creature.

traits.name: Occult
traits.text:
This magic comes from the occult tradition, calling upon bizarre and ephemeral mysteries. Anything with this trait is magical.  
  
A creature with this trait is primarily constituted of or has a strong connection to occult magic.

abilities.trigger: An intruder to the monastery begins their turn in area E3

abilities.name: Melee
abilities.text: branch +17 (magical, reach 40 feet), Damage 1d8+9 bludgeoning plus 1d8 mental

hazard.description: The branches of the stone tree statue animate, extend, and lash out at intruders.
hazard.disable: DC 25 Religion to exorcise the haunt, or DC 28 Intimidation to appear overwhelmingly strong of body and mind
hazard.name: Kugaptee's Tree
hazard.routine: (3 actions) Kugaptee's tree lashes out with its branches, using its three actions to attempt branch Strikes against any creature in reach. Targets that are within reach but are outside of area E3 have cover from the surrounding archways. The haunt favors targets in area E3 but otherwise selects its targets randomly.
